values: Accelerated three-month schedule; planning baseline: 14 July 2026 | target completion: 14 October 2026
Set up object detection, tracking, video I/O, and the initial repository.
Build webcam/dashcam recording, YOLO detection, movement analysis, OCR, and saved-video workflow.
Develop Streamlit dashboard plus incident, vehicle, reporting, storage, and notification services.
Integrate MoviePy/FFmpeg, improve MP4/WebM handling, and enable active location tracking.
Complete vehicle/mobile testing, webcam recorder reliability checks, and media persistence tests.
Resolve test findings; tune recording stability, inference speed, playback, and location accuracy.
Finalize critical incidents, stolen-vehicle checks, analytics, exports, and error handling.
Review authentication, secrets, access controls, retention, backup, and privacy settings.
Run end-to-end driving scenarios, capture acceptance feedback, and fix release-blocking issues.
Complete essential documentation, installation steps, release notes, and deployment checklist.
Deploy a controlled pilot, monitor priority errors, and apply only release-blocking fixes.
Publish production release, hand over essential documentation, and close the project.
